text: Every big goal starts at zero.
Become a software engineer.
Launch your own product.
Run a half marathon.
Three years. One hour a day.
That's over a thousand hours,
and no one tells you what to do with the first one.
So you plan on Sunday.
Miss a day on Wednesday.
And by Friday, the plan is gone.
Because knowing what you want isn't the same as knowing how to get there.
This is Zero to One.
Tell it your goal, where you're starting, and how much time you really have.
It builds a realistic roadmap. Phases. Milestones. Tasks.
You review it, and you approve it.
Then it turns the roadmap into today: exactly what to do next, and when.
Miss a day?
Your plan adapts, instead of piling up.
And an AI assistant explains, suggests and reorganizes, while every decision stays yours.
Progress you can see.
One clear step at a time.
Zero to One. Big goals. Clear next steps.
